In `@gratis-ai-plugin-translations.php`:
- Around line 106-116: The cron event 'gratis_ai_pt_refresh_cache' is being
scheduled (e.g. in function activate() via wp_schedule_single_event) but the
hook callback is never registered; add an
add_action('gratis_ai_pt_refresh_cache', [$this, 'refresh_translations_cache'])
registration in Translation_Manager::init() (or another initialization path that
runs before any scheduling) so the scheduled event invokes
Translation_Manager::refresh_translations_cache; also ensure the same
registration exists before any other schedule calls (manual refresh trigger and
cache-miss scheduling) so the callback is always wired up prior to scheduling.

In `@src/class-admin-settings.php`:
- Around line 315-317: The privacy text under the "Privacy Notice" paragraph no
longer reflects the actual batch payload: src/class-translation-api-client.php
(lines ~98-103) now sends site_url and wp_version in addition to plugin
metadata; update the paragraph in class-admin-settings.php to explicitly
disclose that site_url and WordPress version are sent, or alternatively remove
those fields from the payload in the translation client (the function that
builds/sends the batch request in class-translation-api-client.php). Ensure you
reference the "Privacy Notice" paragraph (the esc_html_e() string) when editing
the text, or modify the batch payload construction in
class-translation-api-client.php to stop including site_url and wp_version.

In `@src/class-translation-manager.php`:
- Around line 509-510: The availability lookup is keyed by plugin slug (from
get_available_translations_map()) but you call has_official_translation() with
the plugin textdomain (variables $textdomain, $available,
$installed_translations), causing mismatches when slug !== textdomain; update
the logic to align keys: either change get_available_translations_map() to key
its update_plugins/available data by textdomain, or translate the $textdomain to
the plugin slug before querying (e.g., build a slug↔textdomain map from the
plugin list and use that to index $available). Apply the same fix for the other
occurrences noted (the blocks around the has_official_translation() calls at the
regions referenced, e.g., lines 549–563 and 573–585) so all availability checks
use the same key (slug or textdomain) consistently.
- Around line 243-249: The code assigns $slug from dirname((string)
$plugin_file) which yields '.' for single-file plugins, causing invalid cache
keys; update the slug normalization before populating $slug_map so that if $slug
=== '.' or empty you compute a proper root-level slug (e.g., use
sanitize_title((string) $plugin_file) or basename without the .php extension)
and then set $slug_map[$textdomain] = $slug; adjust the logic around $slug,
$slug_map, and where $version_map/$needed_map are populated to ensure one-file
plugins get a normalized slug.
- Around line 305-316: The finalize_refresh method currently writes a snapshot
to set_site_transient('gratis_ai_pt_translations_cache', ...) even when the
refresh is incomplete (e.g., work queued and entries lack package_url), causing
stale/invisible packages; change finalize_refresh in
class-translation-manager.php to only set the translations cache when the
refresh appears complete — for example, require pending === 0 and that every
entry in $entries contains a package_url (or other finalization marker) before
calling set_site_transient; otherwise skip setting the cache (but still update
pending/last_check/options). Also use the public filter
gratis_ai_pt_cache_duration when deciding the TTL instead of hardcoding 6 *
HOUR_IN_SECONDS. Ensure you reference the finalize_refresh function,
$state['entries'], $state['pending'],
set_site_transient('gratis_ai_pt_translations_cache', ...), and the
gratis_ai_pt_cache_duration filter when making the change.
- Around line 642-652: Remove or wire up the unused user-locale scheduling:
either delete the methods schedule_translation_request_for_user and
maybe_request_translations_for_user, or register the missing hooks in
TranslationManager::init()—specifically add_action('profile_update', [ $this,
'schedule_translation_request_for_user' ]) and add_action('user_register', [
$this, 'schedule_translation_request_for_user' ]) (or equivalent), and
add_action('gratis_ai_pt_request_user_locale', [ $this,
'maybe_request_translations_for_user' ]) so the scheduled event has a handler;
ensure the scheduled wp_schedule_single_event() call in
schedule_translation_request_for_user remains consistent with the event name
'gratis_ai_pt_request_user_locale' and that maybe_request_translations_for_user
accepts the same user_id parameter.

call in the admin settings rendering code to use superdav-ai-plugin-translations
instead of superdav-ai-language-packs. Make this change consistently in the
relevant methods that build the status, activity, locales, and language-pack
sections so extraction and runtime lookup match the project standard.

state as “running” even when wp_next_scheduled() has no pending event, which can
leave the admin page showing a perpetual active scan. Update the status handling
in class-admin-settings.php so the logic that builds $refresh_status
distinguishes a lost/stalled scan from an actually running one, and either mark
it as stalled/unscheduled or trigger a reschedule before the UI renders. Keep
the existing running/scheduled/idle display in the settings view, but ensure the
branch that currently falls back to running cannot report stale state as active.
- Around line 601-603: The is_translation_locale() check only excludes en_US,
en, and site-default, so other English variants like en_GB and en_AU still pass
through. Update the locale filter in is_translation_locale() to exclude all
English locale variants, likely by checking the language prefix or expanding the
English exclusion logic, while keeping the non-empty guard and the existing
method signature intact.
- Around line 259-260: The progressbar in the class-admin-settings rendering has
no accessible name, so add an aria-label or aria-labelledby to the
sd-ai-lang-packs-progress element. Update the progress markup in the settings
output so the existing aria-valuenow/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax are paired with
a clear label that describes what the progress represents.
- Around line 831-833: The cache key setup in the `.mo` handling path still
assumes `filemtime()` and `filesize()` succeed after the `is_readable()` check,
which can trigger warnings if the file disappears. Update the logic around the
`$mo_file` stat calls to verify both `filemtime()` and `filesize()` returned
valid values, and have the method return 0 immediately if either stat call fails
before building the `mo_strings_` cache key.
- Around line 536-557: The locale summary built in Class_Admin_Settings is
recalculated by scanning users and sites on every status page load, which can be
too slow on large networks. Add caching for the computed locale summary in the
method that gathers locales (using the existing add_locale_source flow), and
return the cached result when available instead of repeating get_users/get_sites
scans. Make sure the cache is invalidated or refreshed when relevant locale data
changes so the summary stays accurate.
